# Forensic Report Workflow

## When to Use
- Building investigation reports section-by-section.
- Ensuring evidence-backed narrative generation.
- Validating final exports and report integrity.

## Procedure
1. Define report scope and required sections.
2. Generate or update section content with evidence references.
3. Ensure claims map to evidence keys before finalizing narrative.
4. Validate layout and export behavior in Studio V4.
5. Run checks from [report checklist](./references/report-checklist.md).

## Output Checklist
- Section status map
- Evidence linkage status
- Export validation status
- Open risks and missing evidence
